# GnuCOBOL 3.2 -> gnucobol-rs FILE CENSUS -- every file accounted for, with a gap note + plan

> Goal: **not a single file** of the admitted GnuCOBOL 3.2 source is left unaccounted for. Every file
> is enumerated below with its parity status and -- where it is not already done -- a concrete plan to
> bring it to full parity. Statuses: **PORTED**/**PORTED+EVIDENCED** (1:1 in the runtime, oracle-sealed)
> · **COPIED+WIRED** (config copied verbatim + parsed natively) · **PARTIAL** (e.g. runtime messages) ·
> **GAP -> front-end / cobrun** (the clean-room interpreter roadmap) · **OBVIATED** (build system that
> Cargo replaces) · **CONSUMED-AS-ORACLE** (the GnuCOBOL test suite, used as the oracle) ·
> **REFERENCE** / **TEST-DATA**.
## At a glance

**Built natively (ported / copied+wired / partial): 64 files** · **active gaps: 25** (cobc front-end + cob-config CLI) · **partial (reproduced subset): 2** · the rest is reference / test-corpus / Cargo-obviated. This census is regenerated by `cargo run -p xtask -- cobol-parity generate` and **reality-checked** by `cobol-parity check` (status/evidence consistency + `proof` anchors that must resolve in the live tree), wired into the doc-refresh gate so it cannot silently go stale.

**Receipts: every one of the 329 files carries a receipt** -- 304 with positive evidence (the Rust module / config copy / test / oracle role that proves it is accounted for) and 25 explicitly marked **UNEVIDENCED-GAP** with a plan (nothing is silently omitted). **Active gaps: 25 files** -- the cobc compiler -> clean-room front-end (`cobrun`) and the `cob-config` flags reporter; files reproduced as a verified subset are marked **PARTIAL** (with a `proof` anchor), not GAP. Everything else is ported, copied, obviated by Cargo, or reference. The plans are the road to full 1:1 parity.
